arguments.sql: SELECT u.id AS user_id, SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY total_usd DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Sums all transaction amounts per user across their cards and returns the five largest totals, highest first, with the user id and total in dollars.
assumptions: 'Spent' means the net sum of amount_usd_cents over all of a user's transactions, across all their cards, over the whole period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
The 56900 negative amounts are included as recorded in the net total, since their meaning is undocumented and they are not assumed to be refunds.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, since the question asks for total spend, not fraud.
Ties in total are ordered by user id ascending.
